summary: The 2017 site for Faune, Alice Savoie's free type family commissioned by the French Centre National des Arts Plastiques with the Imprimerie Nationale, built from three animal 'parents' (viper → Thin, ram → Black, ibis → Bold Italic) and their interpolations. Captured from the Wayback Machine, so fonts, figures and the hero partly failed: navy, mint and pale-yellow sections hold a foreword, quotes with a Thin↔Black interpolation slider computed in a web worker, a long illustrated essay, a 'mix-and-match' chimera maker with share buttons, a download section with licence and install notes, and credits.

instances.look: On deep navy, 'faune' set huge in white, split in two halves: 'fau' in Thin on the left and 'ne' in Bold Italic on the right; credits below (designed by Alice Savoie, illustrations by Marine Rivoal, commission by the CNAP with the Imprimerie Nationale), 'Menu' at the left edge, 'Français' top-right, a down chevron and a mint strip at the bottom. The crop itself is covered by the 'faune / Please wait while we are loading this website' loader; the real hero is visible only in the video
instances.ux: Arrow scrolls to the foreword; language switch; the hero holds left/right halves of eight animal engravings (viper, rabbit, ibis, hedgehog, owl, chameleon, ram, whale) that presumably pair up behind the two halves of the name
instances.learn: Split the name between two parent styles (Thin | Bold Italic), mirroring how the family was bred from different 'parents'
